decision_summary: The immutable proposal and validation bindings, current canonical base, complete 54-entry semantic read set, five-new-node and nine-new-edge write set, independently reconstructed candidate hash, typed acyclic graph, trusted-closure behavior, status labels, and protected-node policy all check exactly. The frozen analytic package and distinct independent audit establish the declared relay-sign-independent conditional local-to-global theorem and its restricted min-law corollary only at n=2, mu=2: the global indexed residual is continuous, has at most one zero across all relay chambers and compatible closures, every zero is automatically premise-complete with four transverse active events, and any zero is reflection fixed. The proof does not assert root existence, general min mu or n, equal norm, or O3a. No numerical or external-source premise is used, and no blocking or major finding remains.

ordered_step_reconstruction: The cell energy E=P^2-Q^2+rho S equals 1-q^2<0 and is preserved at relay events because the coefficient jump is multiplied by S=0. A nonjoint tangency would give E=(mu^2-1)Q^2>=0, while a joint zero has P^2-mu^2 Q^2<0 and hence a strict punctured S<0 quadratic contact.

The zero classification determines the outgoing relay label uniquely. A finite Zeno accumulation would produce S=S_t=0 by continuity and Rolle; nonjoint accumulation contradicts the tangency exclusion and joint accumulation contradicts the punctured negative neighborhood. Thus the relay IVP is unique and global on finite horizons.

On compact q intervals, uniform state bounds yield subsequential compactness. Limit zeros inherit the same isolated classification, material labels stabilize off finitely many zero neighborhoods, and dominated convergence in the integral equations identifies every subsequential limit with the unique relay trajectory. This proves q-continuity without fixing a material word.

Lifted scalar phase has derivative at least one and every scalar zero is simple, so indexed zero times exist on uniform finite horizons and vary continuously. Hence A_n(mu,q)=T_U^n-T_V^(n+1) is a single continuous function on q>1 across all chambers and compatible closures.

At A_n=0, U and V are consecutive Dirichlet modes. Strict interlacing and W=V_t U-V U_t with W_t=-(mu^2-1)rho UV give W<0. Therefore V/U decreases on each U nodal cell; its endpoint ranges cross +1/mu and -1/mu exactly once per cell, yielding exactly 2n simple transverse active S-events, negative endpoint cells, and no interior joint zero. Every residual zero is automatically premise complete.

Continue the final rho_- chamber smoothly across the terminal joint contact. Its switching function has a strictly negative quadratic leading term and vanishing first q-variation at the common terminal zero. Actual and chamber flows can differ only over an O(|q-q0|) window where positions are O(|q-q0|); the vector-field mismatch is O(|q-q0|), giving velocity error O((q-q0)^2), position error O(|q-q0|^3), and indexed zero-time error O((q-q0)^2). Thus the global and chamber derivatives agree at terminal event-pair birth or death.

A continuous real function differentiable at all zeros and having one strict oriented derivative sign at every zero has at most one zero. Applying this lemma to sigma A_n gives global at-most-one across chambers and closures.

Positive reorientation of the reflected root preserves the sign of S, the relay orientation, and nodal indices and produces q#=|V_t(L)|/|U_t(L)|>1. It is another zero of the same residual. At-most-one gives q#=q and IVP uniqueness identifies the reflected trajectory with the original.
